CF V3 — Interactive Emissions Dashboard (+HEV)

Optimal vehicle choice (BEV / PHEV / HEV) and battery capacity over the (mean daily distance m, std std) grid, solved in closed form. Every parameter is a live slider on the left; the heatmaps and readouts update as you drag them. Full methodology: "Why Clean Grids Aren't Enough: A Closed-Form Framework for Battery Sizing and Vehicle Choice Under Stochastic Demand."

Generated by interactive_dashboard_hev_web.py from params.py / precompute.py — re-run the script to refresh after changing those files. (2026-09-28 15:54)

Every parameter build_coefficients() consumes is a slider above, plus HEV's own fuel-economy/M_body sliders (HEV has no range/battery decision, mirroring ICEV) -- nothing else is held fixed except the grid resolution itself. Fuel economy is entered as MPG/MPGe (converted via the EPA gasoline-gallon-equivalent constant, 33.7 kWh/gge) and battery/body service life as years -- both converted internally to the kWh/km and days the model actually consumes. Grid: m∈[0.1,300] km, std∈[0.1,300] km, 150×150 points. m_min lowered from params.py's own GRID['m_min']=5 to 0.1 to show the near-zero-travel region where ICEV/HEV win by avoiding BEV/PHEV's mandatory minimum-battery manufacturing floor.
